sn22.94:1.2: nāhaṃ bhikkhave, lokena vivadāmi. loko va kho bhikkhave, mayā vivadati.
sn22.94:1.3: na bhikkhave, dhammavādī kenaci lokasmiṃ vivadati.
sn22.94:1.4: yaṃ bhikkhave, natthisammataṃ loke paṇḍitānaṃ ahampi taṃ natthīti vadāmi.
sn22.94:1.5: yaṃ bhikkhave, atthisammataṃ loke paṇḍitānaṃ ahampi taṃ atthīti vadāmi.
sn22.94:2.1: kiñca bhikkhave, natthisammataṃ loke paṇḍitānaṃ yamahaṃ natthīti vadāmi.
sn22.94:2.2: rūpaṃ bhikkhave, niccaṃ dhuvaṃ sassataṃ avipariṇāmadhammaṃ natthi sammataṃ loke paṇḍitānaṃ ahampi taṃ natthīti vadāmi.
sn22.94:2.3: vedanā niccā dhuvā sassatā aviparināmadhammā natthisammatā loke paṇḍitānaṃ ahampi taṃ natthīti vadāmi.
sn22.94:2.5: saṅkhārā niccā dhuvā sassatā aviparināmadhammā natthisammatā loke paṇḍitānaṃ ahampi taṃ natthīti vadāmi.
sn22.94:2.6: viññāṇaṃ niccaṃ dhuvaṃ sassataṃ avipariṇāmadhammaṃ natthisammataṃ loke paṇḍitānaṃ ahampi taṃ natthīti vadāmi.
sn22.94:2.7: idaṃ kho bhikkhave, natthisammataṃ loke paṇḍitānaṃ yamahaṃ natthīti vadāmi.
sn22.94:3.1: kiñca bhikkhave, atthisammataṃ loke paṇḍitānaṃ yamahaṃ atthīti vadāmi.
sn22.94:3.2: rūpaṃ bhikkhave, aniccaṃ dukkhaṃ vipariṇāmadhammaṃ atthisammataṃ loke paṇḍitānaṃ ahampi taṃ atthīti vadāmi.
sn22.94:3.3: vedanā aniccā dukkhā viparināmadhammaṃ atthisammatā loke paṇḍitānaṃ ahampi taṃ atthīti vadāmi, saññā …pe… saṅkhārā aniccā dukkhā vipariṇāmadhammā atthisammatā loke paṇḍitānaṃ ahampi taṃ atthīti vadāmi,
sn22.94:3.4: viññāṇaṃ aniccaṃ dukkhaṃ viparināmadhammaṃ atthisammataṃ loke paṇḍitānaṃ ahampi taṃ atthīti vadāmi.
sn22.94:3.5: idaṃ kho bhikkhave, atthisammataṃ loke paṇḍitānaṃ yamahaṃ atthīti vadāmi.
sn22.94:4.1: atthi bhikkhave, loke lokadhammo yaṃ tathāgato abhisambujjhati abhisameti
sn22.94:4.2: abhisambujjhitvā abhisametvā ācikkhati deseti paññapeti paṭṭhapeti vivarati vibhajati uttānīkaroti.
sn22.94:5.1: kiñca bhikkhave, loke lokadhammo yaṃ tathāgato abhisambujjhati, abhisameti. abhisambujjhitvā abhisametvā ācikkhati deseti, paññapeti, paṭṭhapeti, vivarati vibhajati uttānīkaroti?
sn22.94:5.2: rūpaṃ bhikkhave, loke lokadhammo, taṃ tathāgato abhisambujjhati abhisameti.
sn22.94:5.3: abhisambujjhitvā abhisametvā ācikkhati deseti paññapeti paṭṭhapeti vivarati vibhajati uttānīkaroti.
sn22.94:6.1: yo bhikkhave, tathāgatena evaṃ ācikkhiyamāne desiyamāne paññāpiyamāne paṭṭhapiyamāne vivariyamāne vibhajiyamāne uttānīkayirayamāne na jānāti na passati tamahaṃ bhikkhave, bālaṃ puthujjanaṃ andhaṃ acakkhukaṃ ajānantaṃ apassantaṃ kinti karomi.
sn22.94:6.5: viññāṇaṃ bhikkhave, loke lokadhammo. taṃ tathāgato abhisambujjhati abhisameti.
sn22.94:6.6: abhisambujjhitvā abhisametvā ācikkhati deseti paññapeti paṭṭhapeti vivarati vibhajati uttānīkaroti.
sn22.94:7.1: yo bhikkhave, tathāgatena evaṃ ācikkhiyamāne desiyamāne paññāpiyamāne paṭṭhapiyamāne vivariyamāne vibhajiyamāne uttānīkayiramāne na jānāti na passati. tamahaṃ bhikkhave, bālaṃ puthujjanaṃ andhaṃ acakkhukaṃ ajānantaṃ apassantaṃ kinti karomi.
sn22.94:8.1: seyyathāpi bhikkhave, uppalaṃ vā padumaṃ vā puṇḍarīkaṃ vā udake jātaṃ udake saṃvaddhaṃ udakā accuggamma ṭhāti. anupalittaṃ udakena,
sn22.94:8.2: evameva kho bhikkhave, tathāgato loke jāto loke saṃvaddho lokaṃ abhibhuyya viharati anupalitto lokenāti.
